'''Vega Squadron''' is a Russian esports organization with teams in ''League of Legends'', ''Dota 2'', and ''Hearthstone'', formed in 2012. The organization entered ''League of Legends'' by acquiring the CIS team [[Carpe Diem]] on December 2015.<ref name="Vega Squadron announces League of Legends roster">[http://en.vega-squadron.com/news/vega-squadron-announces-league-legends-roster Vega Squadron announces League of Legends roster] ''vega-squadron.com''</ref>
